messages.content: not sure what to do at night, I want to stay up and meditate sitting down and not sleeping

As Elijah from DhO: My new practice log describes, "desire for deliverance phenomenology" can be a strong force. 
Helpful: "When a person seeks relief from stress (dukkha) in the mere practice of meditation itself, they are cutting themselves short of attaining the goal of Dhamma" 
What is driving your desire to meditate at night and not sleep?
